title: Grateful Dead Live at Shoreline Amphitheatre on 1988-09-30
source: Beyerdynamic M-88's XY60 with Sony WMD6-C (Maxell MX 90 No nr)  Offical taping section front of lawn 140 feet away ,dead center Mic stand at 7 feet

ai_review.summary: Decent tape with modest sound; Black Peter shines while the rest of the show feels punchless.
ai_review.review: The recording is a typical taper's capture – listen first to gauge quality, as it lacks some punch in the mix. Musically the highlight is a strong performance of "Black Peter," and the second‑set opener (Bertha → Playing In The Band → Terrapin Station) is pleasant, but much of the remainder falls flat.

ai_rating.rationale: Only two reviews (one very brief) with mixed opinions; show quality is average with a clear standout track, while recording quality is only vaguely described and seems merely adequate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes the tape is "punchless" and suggests listening before downloading; no specific comments on soundboard vs. audience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set opens strong with Bertha, Playing In The Band and Terrapin Station, but the energy wanes afterward, leaving much of the show feeling flat.
